fact: Flann 要 Diarban 唱《Cormach the Lame and the Valley of Death》，意在让 Sir Aidan 想起本乡的历史。
anchor: Do you remember how to play ‘Cormach the Lame and the Valley of Death’?

fact: Flann 与 Tynon 从马背上卸下两只用粗山羊毛布包着的重物，拆开是涂着沥青的木桶，里面装的是 rock oil。
anchor: worked to free their bundles from their wrappings, revealing two pitch-smeared wooden barrels

fact: Tynon 把整桶油倒进烟囱岩与山脊之间的裂隙，Flann 往空桶里丢进燃着的布包，连桶掷下后浓烟腾起（烟粉出自 Tika 之手）。
anchor: Tynon tipped the opened barrel over the huge gap between the chimney-rock and the ridge

fact: 峡谷另一端的出口被一块巨石堵住，Crows 全数已到巨石之外。
anchor: a huge, rounded shape appeared just beyond the narrow, opposite end of the valley

fact: 地下 pucai 大巢被激怒，蚁群般从岩壁涌出，把雇佣兵的后卫成片吞没。
anchor: Goblins! And by all the gods in Heaven, they are endless!

fact: 逃亡队伍此时已近 two score（约四十人），仍远不足以对抗两百名草甸雇佣兵。
anchor: they numbered almost two score, but they were still far too few

fact: Flann 说 Hagan 与 Phelan 夺走了他家族的遗产却夺不走他的记忆，所以这山里乃至地下会动的一切他都清楚。
anchor: Hagan and Phelan stole my heritage but not my memories

fact: Sir Aidan 与纹身草甸雇佣兵头目在谷口争吵之后，他的 Latterban 家兵始终没有跟进，最后掉头回沼泽。
anchor: Aidan and his Latterban household guard did not follow
